topic: Interaction of Light on Different Materials
key_concepts: Visible light is a form of energy seen when reflected off objects
The sun is the primary source of visible light
White light is made up of the colors of the light spectrum or rainbow colors
Optics is the branch of physics that studies light and its interactions
Absorption changes light into energy that heats the material
Reflection happens when light bounces back from an object
Transmission happens when light passes through a material
Refraction is the bending of light as it passes through different materials
Objects appear a certain color because they reflect that color and absorb others
Transparent materials allow most light to pass through, translucent materials transmit and
